app "Run rounds" run mint
table run km num 0.1..100
state left num = 100
state go bool = no
every 1s if go set left = left - 1
when go and left <= 0 set go = no then add run km = max(run.km)
draw 100, 100 width 90
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (20 + 40 * clamp(left / max(run.km), 0, 1)) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 54, left big
  label 50, 56, "Rounds done" faint
"Lap" 400 - min(left, 20) "m" faint

app "Speech practice" note mint
table drill name text, mins num 0..300
state left dur = 300s
state going bool = no
every 1s if going set left = left - 1s
when going and left <= 0s set going = no then notify "Low is due"
floor(left / 1m) "m" big
"Best" max(drill.mins) "min" faint
row gap 1
  each drill sort at as d
    stack grow tap set d.mins = d.mins - 1
      draw width 36
        circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(d.mins <= 0, bad, if(d.mins <= 10, warn, good))
        rect 0, 0, 38, 50 fill ink radius 2
        circle 50, 50, 48 stroke soft thick 8
        arc 50, 50, 46, 0, 38 * clamp(left / 1m, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
        label 50, 48, left big
button "Reset" tap set going = no then set left = 300s then set going = no

app "Ludo" dice plum

  each 1..4 as k
    let ro = count(point where team = Red) % 6
    stack card align center pad 3 fill red
      "Red" bold
      ro big

  row gap 1
    each 1..4 as k
      button it grow tap add point team = Green, pts = it
  button "New game" tap remove all point
